items.title: 10.8 Electrolysis ke doran jama hone wale madde ki miqdar (mass) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.8, printed pages 221-222.

blocks.text: Electrolysis ke doran electrode par banne wale substance ki mass do cheezon ke mutanasib (proportional) hai: mustaqil current kitni der guzra (time), aur current kitna tez tha (strength).
Current aur time ko mila kar yeh relation milta hai:
Electrolysis mein electrode par banne (ya electrode se hatne) wale substance ki mass electrolyte se guzarne wali bijli ki miqdar (coulombs) ke mutanasib hai.

Bijli ki miqdar aksar Faraday (symbol F) naam ki unit mein likhi jati hai. 1 Faraday woh charge hai jo 1 mole electrons ya 1 mole singly charged (ek charge wale) ions le jate hain. Is ki value 96500 C mol⁻¹ hai.
Silver nitrate solution ki electrolysis mein cathode par silver jamti hai:

blocks.text_alt: Ag⁺(aq) + e⁻ → Ag(s) (1 mol, 1 mol, 1 mol)

blocks.text: 1 mole silver jamane ke liye 1 Faraday (96500 C) chahiye. Copper(II) sulfate solution ki electrolysis mein cathode par copper jamta hai:
Equation batati hai ke Cu²⁺ ions se 1 mole copper banane ke liye 2 moles electrons chahiye. Is liye 1 mole copper ke liye 2 Faraday (2 × 96500 C) chahiye.

blocks.latex: \text{Faradays ki tadaad} = \text{liye ya diye gaye electrons ke moles}
blocks.text_alt: Faradays ki tadaad = liye ya diye gaye electrons ke moles

blocks.caption: Har mole product ke liye Faradays

blocks.prompt: 108 g silver, 63.5 g copper aur 27 g aluminium jamane ke liye kitne Faraday chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Har ek mass ek mole hai. Ag⁺ ko 1 mole electrons: 1F. Cu²⁺ ko 2: 2F. Al³⁺ ko 3: 3F.

items: Q = I × t (coulomb = ampere × second); jami hui mass guzre hue charge ke mutanasib.
1 F = 96500 C = 1 mole electrons ka charge.
Faradays ki tadaad = electrons ke moles: Ag ke liye 1F, Cu ke liye 2F fi mole.
